name: Awake With a Roar
text:
Trigger You Rouse the World.

---
When you Rouse the World, it awakens with a mighty yawp that stuns the unsuspecting. All enemies in the area must attempt a Will save save against your world rouser DC. A creature that attempts this save or observes this ability becomes temporarily immune to it for 24 hours.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2 and Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 3 and stunned 1.
